issues.problem: Amazon's fiscal 2024 net income was about $59.2 billion, not $74.1 billion. The stated figure is also higher than the reported $68.6 billion operating income, which doesn't fit Amazon's results. The text includes an embedded note saying net income was 'already verified,' but nothing backs that up, so I checked the figure like the others.

data.summary: These figures match Amazon's fiscal 2024 results: revenue of $638.0B, up 11% from $574.8B; operating income of $68.6B; total assets of $624.9B; and cash and cash equivalents of $78.8B. Net income is wrong. It was about $59.2B, not $74.1B.
